name: AW Battle of the Warriors 2006 (part one)

First round: Rated R wins with the Restricted.

First round: Nameless drags Walters to the ring, floors the referee and the security guards, and is announced the winner by forfeit.

Second round: Tommy Purr pulls Nameless's mask, Bombshell holds the champion's fist and Tommy low-blows him; the referee calls for the bell. Scavenger later lists Tommy Purr among those who did not advance, so Nameless moves on; the page does not name a method.

Second round: The Nameless chokeslams Myst out of the ring while Rated R holds a pin attempt on her; the page does not describe the finish. Scavenger lists Myst among those who did not advance, so Rated R moves on.
Semi-final: Jack wins with the Pumpkin Bomb and is in the final.
Semi-final: Rated R wins with the Restricted; the page calls it the toughest match of the night.
Final, for a million dollars: the page breaks off at a Part Two link before a result.

appearances.note: Simon destroys Vesuvius inside a glass chamber in the opening video package.

notes: The first half of Anarchy Wrestling's first Battle of the Warriors pay-per-view, built on a sixteen-man single-elimination tournament for a million dollars. Vesuvius pulls Thibor Dragosani from his first-round match with Hoshi Yakamoto, and she moves on by a bye; The Nameless is awarded the forfeit over Dustin Walters after carrying him to the ring. Scavenger announces that Q, Daniel McCoy, Tommy Purr and Myst, beaten in the second round, will meet for a new Anarchy Monarchy title. The page ends in the middle of the final, Rated R against Halloween Jack, with a Part Two link; the winner is named on the 25 January 2006 Assault. Part two is a separate page. Not every segment of the card is structured here; the served page is the whole record.

Japhy Ryder calls for the bell and counts both men out; Nameless goes on beating Rated R, who leaves on a stretcher.

notes: The second half of the pay-per-view after a thirty-minute break: a battle royal for a new Superior title, the Anarchy Monarchy four-way, a one-hundred-thousand-dollar three-way, a ten-person Family Affair tag elimination written in another hand, and a main event in which The Nameless, the AW champion, wrecks Rated R. notes: Billed as the first full AW show in nearly a month, a single-elimination tournament for a million dollars, with Rated R the AW champion beaten in the first round by Van Wyld. Max Cameron beats Van Wyld in the final and takes the million; Rated R's chair shots from the front row decide two of Van Wyld's wins. A first-round triple threat of Pyro, Tanja Michaels and Tommy Purr ends when Pyro's knee gives out; the second round then has Tommy Purr and Tanja Michaels against Myst. name: CWA Terror in the Aisles (CWA Originals)

date.source: the page's own heading, June 3rd, 2006 from Vancouver BC

matches.stipulation: CWA Originals catfight, ten women, over the top rope eliminates
matches.note: Cordelia Parizi is the last woman in the ring when Corina hits the floor.

matches.stipulation: CWA Originals battle royal, over the top rope eliminates; Sandman, Gravity and Arizona and, separately, Dwayne Kingston and Tough Eagle crash it
matches.note: Bruce Miller wins, last left in the ring against Steve Hawkins after a spinning power slam and a spear dumps Hawkins out.
Bombshell pins Hoshi Yakamoto; the crowd boos the decision.
Cordelia Parizi comes out instead, says Kathy Smith is out cold in her locker room, and Sybal gets the win by forfeit.
Wren wins with a Flock-assisted F5 by Frank Merritt.
Gerard wins with the Sugar and Spite hold.
Sal Clemenzo pins Diablo after BasketKase, who has thrown blood into his eyes, is thrown out by Sal.
Bullrush pins Freak, Himself after Trinity Holmes' five star frog splash.
The Moose pile-drives Leech on the roof of a car.
Noah Skanes wins with a Rock Bottom.
Razorblade will not release Dizz's ankle after the break and is disqualified; Dizz wins.
Vigilante wins with the Rock Bottom.
Dante throws salt in Rated R's eyes and the Nameless comes out for the pair; the referee calls for the bell, and Cordelia Parizi says that Myst and Shannon win by DQ.
Myst wins.

notes: The first CWA-branded event, on the page's own account, in over a year, staged at GM Place a day before Anarchy Wrestling's BiTCHSLAP. A card of returning CWA names, billed CWA Originals, opens with a ten-woman catfight and a battle royal won by Bruce Miller; Shannon Skanes and Mike Wagner appear backstage to say the CWA is back. Some of the stars wrestle on both shows. The page is explicit in its language and its nudity; it is served unedited under the content notice.
